verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25748341 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318535 (dated 2025-07-28). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,000 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-09-02. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections. The delivery terms text is internally inconsistent.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict themselves: Incoterms EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges freight, insurance and duties), but the text says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. This means extra charges beyond the 6.11 USD unit price may appear on the invoice.
The text states 'DDP is not agreed', while the Seller pre-paying duties and freight resembles DDP-type cost allocation.
The document shows no issue date of its own; only the PO date 2025-07-28 is given.
The unit price is shown without a stated price unit (per piece assumed, but not written).
observations: Clean, typed single-page document; no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
No total line value is shown.
